items.name: clip-vit-base-patch32
items.summary: CLIP-ViT-Base-Patch32是由OpenAI开发的视觉语言模型，连接图像和文本。采用Vision Transformer架构，补丁大小为32，在4亿个图像-文本对上训练。该模型通过比较图像特征与文本描述实现零样本图像分类。支持PyTorch、TensorFlow和JAX等多种框架，并与Transformers库兼容。基于arXiv:1908.04913和arXiv:2103.00020论文研究，具备端点兼容性，适用于视觉任务和跨模态理解。
items.summary_en: CLIP-ViT-Base-Patch32 is a vision-language model developed by OpenAI that connects images and text. It uses a Vision Transformer architecture with patch size 32 and is trained on 400 million image-text pairs. The model enables zero-shot image classification by comparing image features with text descriptions. It supports multiple frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX, and is compatible with Transformers library. Based on research from papers arXiv:1908.04913 and arXiv:2103.00020.

Typical use cases span multilingual search engines, content recommendation systems, and document similarity analysis.
